about.title: About
about.mayorTitle: Mayor of the City of Douala
about.doualais: Dear Doualais, Partners and Friends of Douala,
about.introduction1: Since its launch in 2020, Douala Fiesta has become an essential social and cultural event. This success reflects the dynamism of a city that refuses to be defined only by its economic power.
about.introduction2: Economic capital of Cameroon and true lung of the sub-region, Douala is more than a business crossroads. It is a space of exchange and cultural blending where languages, culinary arts, music and the ambitions of a nation in transformation come together. The Douala Fiesta Festival was born to channel and amplify this immense energy.
about.introduction3: Over 6 editions, our event has gone beyond entertainment to become a true incubator of artistic, social and economic initiatives. It is now a major stage for our musicians, a commercial springboard for our craftspeople, an interactive showcase for our businesses, and a privileged moment of communion for our families.
about.introduction4: In 2026, we take a new step at the Parcours Vita with an edition built around three major axes: promoting our cultural wealth through its most talented representatives, connectivity and innovation for our youth, and local unity and solidarity. I sincerely thank our loyal partners and welcome those joining us to celebrate excellence and build the future of our city.
about.introduction6: Long live the Douala Fiesta Festival 2026! Long live Douala! Long live Cameroon!
about.welcome: Welcome to the official website of the Douala Fiesta Festival 2026: sixteen (16) days of celebration, culture and sharing in the heart of Douala.
about.dates: From December 18, 2026 to January 2, 2027, at the Parcours Vita in Douala, immerse yourself in a unique universe of music, dance, gastronomy and local traditions.
about.missionText: To promote Cameroonian and African culture, strengthen community living and provide a space for entertainment, exchange and showcasing local talent.
about.team: Our team is committed and our values make this festival an essential driver of economic and cultural dynamism.
about.approach1: We take the time to understand the audience's needs to deliver an unforgettable experience
about.approach2: Each activity is unique and reflects the audience's personality
about.approach3: Careful coordination for an impeccable result
about.miss: more than a competition, Miss Douala Fiesta reveals ambassadors of the city and its values.
about.heroes: Douala's talents, neighborhood hope, inspiration for all.
about.funActivities: laughter, games, and camaraderie: a place where every child can have fun!
about.shows: the Douala Fiesta show brings together headliners and young talents through themed concerts (religious, folk, old school, youth, and urban) for a rich, varied, and festive experience open to all.

activities.title: The activities of the
activities.subtitle: From December 18, 2026 to January 2, 2027 at the Parcours Vita, and in the districts of Douala with the caravan.
activities.intro: FESTIVAL DOUALA FIESTA – PÔ LA BWAM! is the city's great popular and cultural gathering. For its 7th edition, the festival goes out to meet the inhabitants of the districts, promotes local talent, supports the economy and strengthens solidarity.

caravan.name: The Caravan
caravan.short: Five stops, five districts: the mobilisation caravan kicks off the festival right where people live.
caravan.text: Five Saturdays, five districts: the mobilisation caravan travels across Douala to bring the festival closer to residents. Each stop hosts the local selections of the programme's activities, and the winners of each district are invited to the final phase at the official Douala Fiesta site.

stops.venues: Pharmacie la Rive · Petit stade NGODI
Kotto Carrefour des immeubles · Carrefour PK14 · Carrefour Bassong Logpom · Carrefour lycée de Makepe · Ange Raphaël

promed.name: PROME'D
promed.short: The economic side of the festival: corporate exhibition, B2B meetings, investor pitches and technology demos.
promed.text: PROME'D welcomes all kinds of companies and offers benefits tailored to each need: visibility, networking, access to financing, advisory expertise and innovation. This strategic business space brings together entrepreneurs, economic decision-makers, investors and innovation players around six programmes:
items: Free consultations in finance, taxation and business law
Pitch sessions in front of investors
promed.closing: PROME'D thus stands as a lever of economic attractiveness for Douala and of national entrepreneurial recognition.

miss.name: Miss Douala Fiesta
miss.short: Glamour at the service of Douala's influence: a Miss and two runners-up, ambassadors of the city.
miss.text: A contest that honours the young women of Douala, combining glamour, charm and cultural influence. More than a beauty contest, a showcase of the city's culture, dynamism and appeal, carried by its future ambassadors.
goals: Promote the image and culture of the city of Douala.
Give young women a platform for expression and visibility.
Strengthen the reach of the Douala Fiesta festival.
Offer partners exposure to a young, engaged and festive audience.
Elect a Miss and two runners-up, ambassadors of the city during their reign.

noel.name: Solidarity Christmas: The Heart's Table
noel.short: On December 25, 2026, a meal, gifts and a show for 500 underprivileged children of Douala.
noel.text: In Douala, hundreds of children have never known the magic of Christmas. No gift to unwrap, no smile shared under the December lights. On December 25, 2026, the Mayor of Douala wants to change that for 500 underprivileged children: a meal, gifts, a show and a play area just for them. A day to give them, for a moment, the childhood they deserve.
goals: Offer a warm and friendly Christmas meal to 500 underprivileged children of Douala.
Give a gift to every child present, to symbolically mark the celebration.
Offer a festive show to create a moment of collective joy.
Set up a friendly children's area to extend the celebration with rest and play.
Strengthen municipal solidarity and mobilise civil society and the private sector around a common cause.
Give positive visibility to the social commitment of the City of Douala and its many partners.

mami.name: Mami Makala & Papa Beignet
mami.short: The Grand Prix honouring the pillars of Douala's informal food scene: a popular, festive and unifying contest.
mami.period: Selections during the caravan, final at the Parcours Vita
mami.text: Mami Makala and Papa Beignet are pillars of informal catering in Douala. Present in every neighbourhood, in the heart of markets, schools and busy streets, they embody the city's entrepreneurial energy and resourcefulness. This Grand Prix honours them through a popular, festive and unifying contest, fully in line with the spirit of Douala Fiesta.
goals: Value these everyday entrepreneurs and their culinary know-how.
Anchor the festival in the neighbourhoods, markets, schools and busy streets of Douala.
Offer a popular, family-friendly entertainment with strong media reach.
Create strong visibility for the festival's partner brands.
mami.stepsTitle: 4 steps: from recruiting candidates to the grand final
steps: Recruitment: purchase of partner products or online registration.
Selection: in each district, 3 candidates per discipline and 1 finalist per discipline.
Master class: capital management, hygiene and safety, product making and preservation.
Grand final: at the Parcours Vita site, 6 candidates per discipline, a jury and the awards.

besua.name: BESUA: Inter-district traditional wrestling
besua.short: The traditional wrestling tournament bringing Douala's communities together: lightweights (-75 kg) and heavyweights (+80 kg).
besua.period: Selections during the caravan, final at the Parcours Vita
besua.text: The inter-district traditional wrestling tournament is part of a drive to bring communities closer together, at a time when living together is at the heart of the economic capital's social and cultural concerns. This activity helps promote the cultural and sporting heritage of the city of Douala.
besua.organisation: Selection phases take place in each district when the caravan passes through. They run over one day in two phases: weigh-in and pre-selection, then eliminations and local final. The best wrestlers of each district then qualify for the grand final at the Douala Fiesta Festival site.
besua.categories: Two categories: lightweights (-75 kg) and heavyweights (+80 kg).

brain.name: Douala Brain Games (4th edition)
brain.short: Seven mind-sport disciplines: draughts, ludo, scrabble, chess, ngeka/songo, langa na tila and puzzle.
brain.period: Eliminations in October-November, finals December 18 to 20, 2026
brain.text: Organised by the Douala Urban Community, the Douala Brain Games expand the practice of mind sports, support young people and offer educational leisure. The 3rd edition took place at the Parcours Vita in Bonamoussadi from December 19 to 21, 2025.
brain.disciplines: Disciplines: draughts, ludo, scrabble, chess, ngeka/songo, langa na tila (duala, bassa, bakoko) and puzzle.
brain.news: New in 2026: pre-selections in every district, langa na tila open to 10-15 year-olds (duala, bakoko, bassa), veterans and juniors categories for songo and ludo, and a puzzle competition run by the Zenith Peak association.
brain.calendar: Eliminations in the cantons (Akwa, Bell, Bassa, Bakoko, Bele-Bele, Deido) in October and November 2026, then final phases at the Parcours Vita from December 18 to 20, 2026.
brain.support: Technical support: Cameroon Chess Federation (FECADE), Cameroon Scrabble Federation (FECASCRAB), Cameroon Draughts Federation and traditional games experts.
